stato.avvio.sotto: Loading the model: a few seconds.
stato.modello.avanzamento: {fatti} of {totale} MB ({pc}%) · this happens once, then the program works offline
inizio.sotto: Sensitive data is replaced before it leaves this PC and put back in the answers.
inizio.tessera.testo.sotto: Paste the text: it is masked and copied for you, ready for the AI. Do the same with the answer and the real values come back.
inizio.tessera.documenti.sotto: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF and whole folders: you give the AI the anonymised copy.
inizio.tessera.guida.sotto: With the keyboard in any program, or automatically in the browser.
inizio.canale.terminale: Claude Code, Codex and other command-line tools
inizio.canale.proxy: For programs that go through a proxy
inizio.grafico.tipi: Kinds of data replaced, last 7 days
inizio.avvertenza.bloccate: Requests blocked in the last 7 days: {n}
inizio.avvertenza.non_riconosciute: Requests in an unrecognised format, sent without replacements, in the last 7 days: {n}
inizio.avvertenza.file_non_mascherati: Files uploaded without masking in the last 7 days: {n}
inizio.avvertenza.valori_in_chiaro: Requests where already-masked values went out in clear in the last 7 days: {n}
aggiornamenti.pronto.sotto: The program closes and reopens by itself in a few seconds.
aggiornamenti.installazione_avviata: Installation started: the program will reopen by itself.
aggiornamenti.nota.installer: Once a day the program reads a public file from the releases page: it sends nothing. An update is accepted only if it carries the author's signature, and it is installed the next time the program starts.
aggiornamenti.nota.store: This copy comes from the Microsoft Store: the Store installs the updates.
aggiornamenti.nota.sorgenti: Running from source: the program tells you when a new version is out, but does not update itself. The check reads a public file and sends nothing.
testo.sotto: To use AI inside any program. Paste here: ordinary text is masked, an answer with placeholders gets its real values back. The result goes to the clipboard by itself. Without opening this page: select some text in any program and press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>S</kbd> to mask it in place.
testo.ingresso: Your text, or the AI's answer
testo.ingresso.sotto: Pasting starts it. If you type, press Ctrl+Enter or choose Mask or Restore yourself.
testo.esempio: Example: Good morning, I am Giulia Ferraresi from Nevatek S.r.l., my number is 347 5551234…
testo.incolla.negato: The browser does not allow reading the clipboard: paste into the box with Ctrl+V.
testo.mascherato.copiato: Masked text copied: now paste it into the AI.
testo.mascherato.fatto: Text masked: copy it and paste it into the AI.
testo.ripristinato.copiato: Real values put back: the text is on the clipboard.
testo.ripristinati: {n} placeholders turned back into real values.
testo.correggi.aiuto: Something wrong? Click a placeholder to leave that value in clear. If something slipped through, select it in the text above (or type it) and press “Mask this too”.
testo.correggi.campo: Something missing? Type what to mask
testo.correggi.mai.fatto: “{valore}” will no longer be masked. Change it in Settings → Recognition.
testo.correggi.sempre.fatto: “{valore}” will always be masked. Change it in Settings → Recognition.
documenti.sotto: For attachments and working folders: you give the AI the anonymised copy, then turn the files it produces back into the real values. Formats: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text, PDF and images. PDFs, scans and photos come out as a text file: text from scans is read automatically and may contain errors, so read it through.
documenti.trascina: Drop files here. In automatic mode a file containing placeholders is restored, the others are anonymised.
documenti.troppo_grande: File larger than 40 MB: use the folder option.
documenti.cartella.sotto: Creates, next to the original, a copy with the same content anonymised (name.anon) or restored (name.ripristinato). Unsupported files are skipped, not copied.
guida.sotto: Omissis replaces personal data with labels such as [PERSONA_1] before a text reaches an AI service, and puts the real values back in the answer. Everything happens on this computer.
guida.testo.1: Copy what you want to give the AI, open Text and press Paste from the clipboard: the masked text is already on the clipboard.
guida.testo.3: Copy the AI's answer and press Paste from the clipboard again: Omissis recognises the placeholders and gives you the text with the real values.
guida.tastiera: 2 · With the keyboard, in any program
guida.tastiera.1: Select the text you want to give the AI, in the program where it is, and press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>S</kbd>: it is replaced in place by the masked version.
guida.tastiera.2: Or copy the text (<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>C</kbd>) and press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>M</kbd>: the clipboard now holds the masked version, ready to paste into the AI.
guida.tastiera.3: Copy the answer and press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>R</kbd>: the clipboard gets the real values back.
guida.tastiera.nota: The two clipboard actions are also in the menu of the Omissis icon near the clock (if you cannot see it, it is under the ^ arrow).
guida.documenti.1: Open Documents and drop the files: the anonymised copy for the AI is downloaded by itself.
guida.documenti.2: For a whole folder press Browse and choose it: the copy name.anon is created next to it.
guida.documenti.3: Drop the files the AI produces in the same way: Omissis recognises the placeholders and puts the real values back.
guida.automatico.testo: With the Omissis extension for Chrome and Edge you do nothing: write on Claude or ChatGPT as usual, and for a moment "data replaced before sending" appears at the bottom right. The same goes for connected desktop apps and command-line tools. Connections are set up once, by whoever manages the computer, from advanced mode.
guida.sapere.1: It is not infallible. A program can miss a piece of data: always read the masked text before sending it, especially if it is sensitive.
guida.sapere.2: Labels are stable. The same person always gets the same label, so a conversation resumed days later can still be restored.
guida.sapere.3: If a red "message not sent" warning appears, protection is off: turn it back on from the Home page or from the icon.
guida.sapere.4: Attachments are anonymised before they leave: Word, Excel, PowerPoint and text keep their format, PDFs and images containing text become text files. A photo with no readable text (a face, a blurred document) goes as it is: do not attach it if it shows people's data.
guida.testo.4: If a value slipped through, or was masked by mistake, correct it under the result: the text is redone and copied again.
guida.tastiera.4: The shortcut letters can be changed, or turned off, in Settings.
impostazioni.sotto: Language, appearance and updates. In advanced mode, also how data is recognised.
impostazioni.avanzata.sotto: Shows the sections for whoever manages the computer: connections, service rules, activity, vault.
impostazioni.da_riavviare: Restart protection from the Home page to apply it.
riconoscimento.modello.sotto: Changing it requires restarting protection. If the model is not on this PC it is downloaded.
riconoscimento.casella.sotto: On Enter, data is replaced right in the message box, before the site or app reads it. It is the defence that best survives changes to the services: leave it on.
riconoscimento.ripristina: Put real values back in answers
riconoscimento.ripristina.sotto: When off, answers keep the placeholders: useful to see what the service receives.
riconoscimento.allegati.sotto: The file you attach to a message (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text, PDF, images containing text) is replaced with its anonymised copy before the site or app receives it. PDFs and images become text files.
riconoscimento.blocca_file.sotto: Applies to files that cannot be anonymised (unsupported formats, files that are too large): when on they are not attached, when off they go as they are and a row is added to Activity.
liste.sempre.sotto: Names of confidential projects, internal codes, terms the model cannot know.
liste.mai.sotto: Added to the well-known names already built in (vendors, products): for example your own company name.
liste.nota: One term per line. Upper and lower case do not matter.
liste.salvate: Lists saved: {sempre} terms to always mask, {mai} never to mask.
collegamenti.sotto: The routes through which protection works by itself. Turn on only the ones you need: they all share the same rules (AI services) and the same vault.
browser.collegamento.sotto: It replaces data before the page sends it and puts it back in the answer, with no proxy and no certificate. It only works together with this program and must be connected once per browser. Until it is connected, or while protection is off, messages to protected services are not sent.
browser.stato.senza_risposta: connected, but protection is not responding
browser.collegata_senza_risposta: Extension connected, but protection is not responding: start it from the Home page.
browser.codice_non_pronto: The code is created the first time protection starts: start it from the Home page.
browser.installazione.1: In the browser open chrome://extensions (in Edge edge://extensions) and turn on Developer mode.
browser.installazione.2: Press Load unpacked and choose this folder:
browser.installazione.3: Open this panel in that browser and press Connect this browser.
browser.installazione.4: Try it with made-up data: in Activity, the extension's rows are marked "extension".
browser.a_mano.sotto: If the panel is open in a different browser from the one with the extension: copy the code and paste it into the extension's small window (the Omissis icon next to the address bar). The code lets its holder use this PC's protection: do not share it.
app.stato.attesa: connected, but NOT verified yet: send a test message with made-up data
app.stato.no: connected, but NOT protected: messages go out in clear
app.numeri: {pagine} windows followed · {messaggi} messages with replacements · {controllati} checked with nothing to replace · {sostituzioni} values replaced · {bloccate} requests blocked
app.sapere.1: Experimental. Claude and ChatGPT for Windows are, underneath, a browser showing the service's site: started from here they get the same protection as the extension, with no certificate and no proxy.
app.sapere.2: The app must be fully closed (including from the icon next to the clock) before you press "Start protected". Conversations are kept; work in progress in the app is interrupted.
app.sapere.3: While the app is open this way, other programs on this PC can control it through the connection port.
app.sapere.4: If Omissis detaches or is closed, messages to protected services stay blocked in the app until you restart it normally.
app.sapere.5: Verified live only on the ChatGPT app, with made-up data. The conversation saved by the service keeps the placeholders: real values are visible only where Omissis is running.
terminale.fermo: off: it starts together with protection
terminale.numeri: {richieste} requests · {messaggi} with replacements · {sostituzioni} values replaced · {bloccate} stopped
terminale.come.sotto: Instead of the real service you point the tool at the Omissis address, which replaces the data, forwards the request and puts the real values back in the answer, including inside the commands and files the tool writes. The lines apply to the PowerShell window you type them in. Credentials pass through unchanged and are never written anywhere.
terminale.riga.openai: Codex and tools using an OpenAI key
terminale.riga.altri: Other compatible services (base address to put in the tool's configuration)
terminale.verificato.1: Claude Code: tested live with a subscription sign-in and one message of made-up data. Not yet with a real working session made of many commands and files.
terminale.verificato.2: OpenAI format (Codex with a key, opencode, aider and compatible services): tested only against a mock service.
terminale.verificato.3: In the technical context these tools send with every request, only personal data is replaced; the rest (text you write, file contents, command output) is processed in full and may end up masked more than necessary.
terminale.verificato.4: Ollama and LM Studio run on this PC: the data does not leave it. Routing them through here only makes sense if the model is on another computer.
proxy.porta.sotto: The proxy listens only on this PC and decrypts only the traffic of the services you chose to protect. After changing it, restart protection.
proxy.certificato.sotto: A program accepts the proxy only if Windows trusts its certificate. It is installed for the current user only, and Windows asks for confirmation. While it is installed, whoever holds the private key in the data folder can read this user's HTTPS traffic.
proxy.certificato.non_creato: not created yet: start protection once
proxy.finestra.sotto: Opens a separate Chrome or Edge window that goes through the proxy, without touching your everyday browser or the Windows settings.
compatibilita.visti.sotto: It updates by itself while you use the services: for each program and version it says when replacement succeeded and whether, afterwards, a format was not recognised. It holds only names, versions and counts, never the texts.
compatibilita.verificati.sotto: What was tested in person before this version (list of {data}). "Live" means on the real service, with made-up data.
servizi.sotto: For each service you choose what to do: the choice applies to every connection. Only what the program can read can be protected.
servizi.radar.nota: Radar services cannot be read: Omissis detects them and, if you choose "Block", stops them in the browser through the extension and in programs that go through the proxy. The basic radar holds the best-known ones; an extended list can be added as a file in the data folder.
rilevati.nota: Which artificial-intelligence tools are on this PC and which services it talks to. Every scan is saved and compared with the previous one: you see what appeared, what is gone and since when something has been there. The label in the Rule column reports the choice made in Rules for that service: it does not say the tool is protected right now. Everything stays on this PC.
rilevati.rete.niente: No contact with AI services detected.
rilevati.contattati: Services contacted through Omissis, last 30 days
rilevati.connessi: AI programs with open connections now
rilevati.dns: AI services recently resolved by this PC
rilevati.dns_vuoto: The Windows DNS cache is empty on this PC, so visited sites cannot be worked out from it. A full history comes from routing traffic through a connection, or from the firewall's DNS logs.
attivita.sotto: One row per request. Only counts and field names appear here, never the texts.
evento.BLOCCATA: il modello non ha rispo: BLOCKED: the model did not answer
evento.messaggio websocket: nessun campo: websocket message: no text field recognised
evento.BLOCCATO messaggio websocket: mot: BLOCKED websocket message: engine not reachable
archivio.sotto: The match between placeholders and real values. It stays on this PC, encrypted with the Windows protection tied to your user, and is what restores the answers. You can look for a value without showing them all: the search also looks at hidden values.
archivio.svuota.testo: Conversations and documents you already anonymised can no longer be turned back into the real values. This cannot be undone.
archivio.cerca: Search a placeholder or a value
archivio.conta: {mostrate} shown of {trovate} found · {totale} in the vault
archivio.elimina.testo: Entries to delete: {n}. Texts and documents containing those placeholders can no longer be turned back into the real values. This cannot be undone.
archivio.pulizia.sotto: A smaller vault exposes less data. What you delete can no longer be restored in old texts; deleted numbers are never reused, so an old placeholder will never point to a different value.
archivio.pulizia.fermi: Delete what you have not used for a while
archivio.pulizia.fermi.sotto: Entries that have not appeared in any message or document for at least the chosen time. If you chose a type above, only entries of that type.
archivio.pulizia.titolo: Delete the entries unused for {n} days?
archivio.pulizia.da_sola.sotto: Every day it removes by itself the entries unused for longer than the chosen time.
tipo.pagine_lette: pages read from the image (read them through)
programma.protezione_non_attiva: Protection is off: start it first.
programma.motore_chiuso: The engine closed while starting (model not found or not enough memory).
programma.proxy_non_parte: The proxy does not start: port {porta} may already be in use.
programma.gateway_porta: Port {porta} is in use by another program.
programma.app_serve_protezione: Protection is off: start it from the Home page before opening the app.
programma.finestra_senza_browser: Neither Chrome nor Edge found on this PC.
programma.testo_troppo_lungo: Text too long (more than {n} characters): for texts like this use Documents with a file.
programma.termine_non_valido: The term must be at least two characters, on a single line.
programma.finestra_gia_aperta: The folder window is already open: look among the Windows windows.
programma.cartella_non_apribile: This folder cannot be opened from here.
icona.aggiornamento_pronto: Version {v} is ready: it will be installed at the next start, or right now from the panel.
appunti.vuoti: There is no text on the clipboard.
appunti.mascherati: {n} values replaced: you can paste now.
appunti.nessun_dato: No sensitive data recognised: the text is unchanged.
appunti.senza_segnaposto: The copied text contains no placeholders.
appunti.ripristinati: {n} placeholders turned back into real values.
appunti.protezione_ferma: Protection is off: the clipboard text has NOT been changed.
appunti.troppo_lungo: Text too long (more than {n} characters): it was not changed. Use Documents with a file.
appunti.sul_posto.nessun_dato: No sensitive data in the selected text: it was left as it was.
appunti.sul_posto.niente_selezionato: No text selected: select the text to mask and try again.
appunti.sul_posto.protezione_ferma: Protection is not active: the selected text was NOT changed.
appunti.sul_posto.solo_appunti: Values replaced: {n}, but the window changed in the meantime: the masked text is in the clipboard, paste it yourself.
appunti.sul_posto.finestra_cambiata: The window changed while you pressed the shortcut: nothing was touched.
appunti.sul_posto.tasti_premuti: Release the shortcut keys and try again.
appunti.sul_posto.terminale: In a terminal the selection is not replaced: copy the text and use the clipboard shortcut.
documenti.errore.office: Office file cannot be read (password-protected or damaged).
documenti.errore.pdf_ripristino: A PDF cannot be restored: use the text or the document produced by the AI.
documenti.errore.immagine_ripristino: An image cannot be restored: use the text or the document produced by the AI.
documenti.cartella_trascinata: A folder cannot be dropped here: use “Whole folder” below and press Browse.
modelli.errore.non_disponibile: {cosa} is not available yet at the expected address.
modelli.errore.collegamento: Connection failed ({motivo}): trying again resumes from where it stopped.
modelli.errore.impronta: {file}: the downloaded file does not match the expected one and was discarded.
modelli.errore.fuori_elenco: The model "{nome}" is not on this PC and is not one the program can download.
modelli.errore.in_corso: A download is already in progress.
aggiornamenti.errore.libreria: The library needed to check the signature is missing: the update cannot be verified.
aggiornamenti.errore.firma: The update sheet has no valid signature: ignored.
aggiornamenti.errore.formato: The update sheet is signed but not in the expected format: ignored.
aggiornamenti.errore.non_da_sola: This copy does not update itself: download the new version from the releases page.
connettore.errore.non_installata: {nome} does not appear to be installed on this PC.
connettore.errore.porta: {nome} did not open the connection port. This usually means it was already running: close it completely (including from the icon next to the clock) and try again. If it was closed, this version of the app does not accept the connection.
scorciatoie.sotto: They work in any program while Omissis is running. Choose the letter to press together with <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>, or turn off the ones you do not use. Avoid letters you type with <kbd>AltGr</kbd> on your keyboard.
scorciatoie.senza_icona: Shortcuts are active when Omissis is started with its icon near the clock.
scorciatoie.sostituisci.sotto: Select some text in any program and press the shortcut: it is replaced in place by the masked version. It does not act in terminal windows.
scorciatoie.maschera.sotto: The text you copied is replaced in the clipboard by the masked version: then you paste it.
scorciatoie.ripristina.sotto: The AI answer you copied goes back to the clipboard with the real values.
scorciatoie.errore.occupata.lungo: {tasti} is already used by another program (or by another copy of Omissis): choose another letter.
inventario.mai_fatta: No scan yet: press Scan now. The first one is the starting point.
inventario.prima_fatta: First scan saved (items: {n}). From now on you will see what changes.
inventario.cambiato: Scan saved. New: {nuovi} · no longer present: {spariti}.
inventario.invariato: Scan saved: nothing changed since last time.
inventario.avviso_nuovi: New AI tools on this PC ({n}): {nomi}. Open AI services → Detected.
inventario.dimentica.niente: Nothing to forget: everything listed is still present.
inventario.dimentica.titolo: Remove from the inventory what is gone?
inventario.dimentica.testo: The items no longer present ({n}) will be removed from the inventory, with their review and note. If they come back they will be reported as new.
